title: DGFT Removes Physical Challans for EODC Applications

blocks.content: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has removed the requirement for physical duty payment challans in applications for Export Obligation Discharge Certificates (EODC) under the Advance Authorisation and Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG) schemes. The change uses direct electronic integration of license-wise voluntary duty payment data from Customs and ICEGATE into the DGFT online system.

items: DGFT stands for Directorate General of Foreign Trade, and it functions under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
ICEGATE stands for Indian Customs Electronic Gateway, which is used for customs data exchange in India.
Advance Authorisation and EPCG are export promotion schemes linked to export obligation fulfilment.
EODC is issued after an exporter completes the export obligation attached to a licence or authorisation.
